Update information

・Add new stage [CURRY].
・Adjust game balance.
・Add Tutorial.

・カレー好きの方に是非プレイして頂きたい！60種類のカレーを用意。「カレー」ステージ追加。
・ゲームバランスを調整。残りタイムが僅かの際に追加されるタイムを増加。より粘り強いプレイが可能に！
・チュートリアルに項目を追加。

notes.title: · Tomica and me and TOM & JERRY
notes.content:
FlatCircle is a Japanese game developer. I am developing it by one person.

I asked Americans for translation in the game. He has a deep insight into various games.
The text of this newsletter is created using Google translation. Pardon a strange place.

· Tomica and me and TOM & JERRY

I will not boast at all, but I've forgotten, dropped and stolen things.
Especially umbrellas are countless. Especially when I forgot my favorite umbrella I was pretty shocked.

The first memorable lost thing & theft is about 5 years old.
I like to collect mini-cars, especially Tomica (one of the most famous toy car brands in Japan), birthday and christmas, some parents bought me some anniversary.
Increasing the collection, looking and like to soak in Yu. I thrust them all in one bag and I always carried around with them.
That's the time to play and sleep.
Bags packed with something I liked were undoubtedly my treasure of those days.

It was when I was playing in a park near my house. Of course have a bag of examples.
Perhaps it was called at lunch, I left the bag and went home.
Why did you forget? . . And I do not remember anything after that.
Later that only the bag remained when returning from the parent to the park. I was told that all of the mini cars were gone.
And I wonder how much I cried.

Where it actually was shocked, only this part is missing from memory,
It can be said also from the fact that it was a pure heart at that time? Well,
I think that it was a moment when I learned the concept of "stealing" and "being stolen".

Why do you still remember this thoroughly? There is a reason for this.
Only the contents were stolen, the empty bag.
It is a bag of TOM & Jerry. I still have this without letting go.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30823549/c7b5e3524839d290d5f6ddd94463a89975bc5c4d.png[/img][img][/img]
Of course I do not carry around, but this old bagged bag itself is a memorable item for me.
An important treasure and a shock event. Feelings of that time. I can remember everything.

The story connecting people and things is a special story only known to the owner.
There is definitely no human being who knows the story and can steal treasure from the hero of the story.
Because you do not know the story, you can definitely steal a person's things, destroy memories.
As long as I have a TOM & Jerry bag, I can cherish my things,
You can surely respect others' things. I believe so.

The story of "WHERE'S PHANTOM THIEF" was made with hints from this experience and way of thinking.
Kaito steals various objects from the museum. Each one is a treasure.
In other words, it is a treasure, memorable item that someone possessed carefully in the past far.
A girl named Feene in the hero, a dog called Mique in partner.
I'm sure they are on better terms than TOM & Jerry.
Very casual, comedy touch, no difficult story comes out. Relieved!

However, if you recall that this story is at the base of the game,
I'm sure that you can enjoy more games.

thank you for reading!

TANAHAMA
